notes.en: [[character:vodyanitsa]] is a support unit that uses her [[ability:skill]] to buff **[[element:freeze]] and [[element:stellar-swirl]]** teams in various ways. She additionaly provides healing and interruption resistance to the active character.
notes.fr: [[character:vodyanitsa]] est un personnage Support qui utilise son [[ability:skill]] pour buff les équipes **[[element:freeze]] & [[element:stellar-swirl]]** de différentes façons. Elle offre aussi du soin et de la résistance à l'interruption pour le personnage actif.
notes.it: [[character:vodyanitsa]] è un personaggio di supporto che utilizza la sua [[ability:skill]] per fornire numerosi vantaggi ai team **[[element:freeze]] e [[element:stellar-swirl]]**. Inoltre, fornisce cure e resistenza all'interruzione al personaggio attivo.

notes.en: **In [[element:freeze]] teams**, she reduces the [[element:hydro]] and [[element:cryo]] RES of opponents hit by her [[ability:skill]]. In addition, [[character:vodyanitsa]]'s A4 talent also increases the [[element:hydro]] and [[element:cryo]] DMG dealt by teammates, which scales based on her Max [[stat:hp|HP]].
notes.fr: **Dans les équipes [[element:freeze]]**, elle réduit la RES [[element:hydro]] & [[element:cryo]] des ennemis touchés par son [[ability:skill]]. De plus, son passif A4 augment aussi les dégâts [[element:hydro]] et [[element:cryo]] de l'équipe, ce qui scale sur ses PV max.
notes.it: Nei team **[[element:freeze]]**, **riduce le RES [[element:hydro]] e [[element:cryo]]** dei nemici colpiti dall'[[ability:skill]]. Inoltre, il suo Talento A4 **aumenta i danni [[element:hydro]] e [[element:cryo]]** inflitti dal team in base ai suoi [[stat:hp]] massimi.

notes.en: **In [[element:stellar-swirl]] teams**, [[character:vodyanitsa]]'s [[ability:skill]] also enhances any [[ability:stellar-vortex]]es created by the [[element:stellar-swirl]] reaction. These enhanced Vortexes, when generated or exploded, also reduce enemies' [[element:anemo]] RES. Her A4 talent will increase the [[element:stellar-swirl]] damage dealt by teammates, which scales based on her Max [[stat:hp|HP]].
notes.fr: **Dans les équipes [[element:stellar-swirl]]**, son [[ability:skill]] améliore les [[ability:stellar-vortex]] créés par la réaction [[element:stellar-swirl]]. Ces vortex améliorés réduisent la RES [[element:anemo]] des ennemis. Son passif A4 augmente les dégâts d'[[element:stellar-swirl]] de l'équipe, ce qui scale sur ses PV max.
notes.it: Nei team **[[element:stellar-swirl]]**, l'[[ability:skill]] di [[character:vodyanitsa]] potenzia anche tutti i [[ability:stellar-vortex]] generati dalla reazione [[element:stellar-swirl]]. Tali Vortici, quando vengono generati o esplodono, **riducono anche la RES [[element:anemo]]** dei nemici. Il suo Talento A4 **aumenta i danni [[element:stellar-swirl]]** inflitti dal team in base ai suoi [[stat:hp]] massimi.

notes.en: Triggering [[element:stellar-swirl]] at least every 8s while [[character:vodyanitsa]]'s [[ability:skill]] is active will prevent her A4 buffs from being applied to [[element:hydro]] and [[element:cryo]] damage, and instead only applied to [[element:stellar-swirl]] damage.
notes.fr: Déclencher [[element:stellar-swirl]] au moins toutes les 8s pendant que le [[ability:skill]] de [[character:vodyanitsa]] est actif empêche le buff de son passif A4 de s'appliquer aux dégâts [[element:hydro]] & [[element:cryo]], et ne s'applique donc qu'aux dégâts d'[[element:stellar-swirl]].
notes.it: Attivare [[element:stellar-swirl]] almeno ogni 8 secondi mentre l'[[ability:skill]] di [[character:vodyanitsa]] è attiva impedisce ai potenziamenti A4 di essere applicati ai danni [[element:hydro]] e [[element:cryo]], applicandoli invece solo ai danni di [[element:stellar-swirl]].

notes.en: [[character:vodyanitsa]]'s A4 talent maximizes at 65,000 [[stat:hp|HP]]. This may be unreasonable to achieve without **[[weapon:hymn-of-the-maelstrom]]**, an **[R5] [[weapon:sacrificial-jade]]** or the assistance of [[element:hydro]] Resonance. Any more beyond this will only increase her healing capabilities and some of her damage.
notes.fr: Le Passif A4 de [[character:vodyanitsa]] atteint son maximum avec 65 000 PV. C'est un montant qui peut être compliqué à atteindre sans **[[weapon:hymn-of-the-maelstrom]]**, **[[weapon:sacrificial-jade]] [R5]** ou la résonnance [[element:hydro]]. Tous les PV au delà de ce montant ne serviront qu'à améliorer ses capacités de soins et ses dégâts personnels.
notes.it: Il Talento A4 di [[character:vodyanitsa]] raggiunge il suo limite massimo a **65.000 [[stat:hp]]**. Potrebbe essere irrealistico raggiungere questo valore senza **[[weapon:hymn-of-the-maelstrom]]**, **[[weapon:sacrificial-jade]] [R5]**, o la risonanzaa [[element:hydro]]. Qualsiasi ulteriore aumento oltre questo limite serve solo ad accrescere le sue cure e parte dei suoi danni.

content.en: [[character:vodyanitsa]]'s DMG buff to both [[element:freeze]] and [[element:stellar-swirl]] teams are provided through **35 Stacks**: 25 to the on-field character, and 10 to the off-field characters. When a character **deals [[element:hydro]], [[element:cryo]], or [[element:stellar-swirl]] DMG**, a Stack will provide at most **3500 DMG** to [[element:hydro]] and [[element:cryo]] DMG, and **6500** DMG to [[element:stellar-swirl]] DMG. These stacks are refreshed when [[character:vodyanitsa]] uses her [[ability:skill]] again.
content.fr: Le buff de dégâts de [[character:vodyanitsa]] apporté aux équipes [[element:freeze]] & [[element:stellar-swirl]] se présente sous la forme de **35 Cumuls**: 25 au personnage on-field, et 10 aux personnages off-field. Lorsqu'un personnage **inflige des dégâts [[element:hydro]], [[element:cryo]], ou [[element:stellar-swirl]]**, un cumul ajoutera au maxiumum **3500** aux dégâts [[element:hydro]] et [[element:cryo]], et **6500** aux dégâts d'[[element:stellar-swirl]]. Ces cumuls sont rafraîchis lorsque [[character:vodyanitsa]] utilise son [[ability:skill]] à nouveau.
content.it: I potenziamenti DAN di [[character:vodyanitsa]] vengono forniti sotto forma di **35 accumuli**: 25 vanno al personaggio attivo, mentre 10 vanno ai personaggi fuori campo. Quando un personaggio **infligge danni [[element:hydro]], [[element:cryo]] o [[element:stellar-swirl]]**, un accumulo fornirà al massimo **3500 DMG** ai danni [[element:hydro]] e [[element:cryo]], e **6500** ai danni [[element:stellar-swirl]]. Questi accumuli vengono rigenerati quando [[character:vodyanitsa]] utilizza nuovamente la sua [[ability:skill]].
